title: Ways to Give
description: Give to the Jewish Caring Network. Every gift reaches a family facing serious illness — through meals, care, respite or a home at Tikva House.

header.heading: Support the Jewish Caring Network
header.lead: Every gift reaches a family facing serious illness — through meals, care, respite or a home at Tikva House.

blocks.markdown:
## Where your gift goes

- Shabbos meals and holiday packages for families at home and in the hospital
- Nursing and respite care when insurance isn’t enough
- Tutoring, camp, birthdays and outings for children
- Kosher hospitality at Tikva House for families traveling for treatment
